prototypes.label: A · Pop eléctrico
prototypes.prompt: Use case: illustration-story. Create ONE vertical 9:16 art-direction prototype for the Spanish curiosity channel ¿Sabías que?, for a simple locally animated 2D comic reel. Reference image is ONLY the existing channel logo: borrow its electric hot magenta, acid lime, crisp black separation and playful graphic energy. Do NOT reproduce the logo or any text. Scene identical across our comparison: a late-1890s steam cruiser sailing across the foreground of Zanzibar harbor, recognizable warm-climate palace facades and palm silhouettes behind, stylized waves. Peaceful explanatory historical illustration, no shooting, explosions, casualties or characters. Dramatically improve the bland muted earlier illustration: electric magenta #FF009D and acid lime #C8FF00 key colors, cyan water, violet shadows, strong black contours. Keep a clear readable focal silhouette, exciting composition yet generous visually quiet bottom 20 percent for later captions. Full bleed portrait, richly designed polished art, not a presentation board. Drawn 2D, no photorealism, no realistic 3D rendering, no beige/sepia wash, no tiny architectural etching, no lettering, no labels, no watermark. Style A: bold graphic pop-art comic. Thick confident black ink, predominantly flat screenprinted color blocks, controlled large halftone patches, big magenta sky shape against acid lime palace highlights, simplified striking geometric ship, crisp poster clarity. Exaggerate silhouette and perspective moderately. Energetic but exceptionally clean and easy to read at phone size.
